text: Appeal of Order to Comply (November 30, 2021) for 30 Crane Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply (November 30, 2021) for 30 Crane Avenue, Folder Number 20 224187 PRS 00 IV, and, in doing so, granted an extension of time to June 30, 2022 to complete all work.
